data.one_liner: Generates and displays dynamic user interfaces in Flutter using AI.
data.what_it_does: GenUI allows you to build dynamic, conversational user interfaces where the UI is constructed by an AI in real-time based on conversations with the user. It provides a Conversation facade, customizable widget catalogs, reactive data models, and transport adapters to handle incoming A2UI message streams.
use_when: You want to build applications where the UI is generated dynamically by an LLM or AI agent.
You need a conversational UI that can update components and data models on the fly.
avoid_when: Your application requires a completely static, pre-defined user interface.
You are not using an AI model or backend to generate dynamic UI definitions.
strengths: Enables real-time, context-aware, and interactive generative user interfaces.
Flexible backend-agnostic design with custom widget catalogs and reactive data binding.
weaknesses: Relies heavily on external LLM response reliability and structured streaming.
Requires custom bridge implementation for your specific AI agent provider.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding network client entitlements for iOS or macOS if making outbound network requests, and implementing an AI transport adapter.
